TK-mac Update: Improved Stability

We’ve made critical improvements to ensure your Mac stays fast and responsive.

  • 🚀 Critical Stability Fix: We have addressed a resource management issue that could cause memory pressure or unresponsiveness during extended use. This update ensures TK-mac runs efficiently and stays light on your system resources, no matter how long the app is kept open.
  • ⚡ Enhanced Performance: By optimizing how TK-mac communicates with background system services, we have significantly reduced the app's overall memory footprint and improved long-term stability.
  • 🛠️ General Refinements: We’ve squashed several minor bugs to ensure a smoother, more reliable experience across all dashboards.

Thank you for your patience and for your continued feedback, which helps us make TK-mac the best it can be.
